digest.component_or_area: test harness and repo isolation guards
propositions: Detached pytest runs via nohup report test failures that do not reproduce in foreground shells, creating false-positive signals that waste investigation effort

The reported failures are caused by concurrent external actors mutating the shared checkout (file creation, branch switches, process reaping) rather than by detachment itself; detachment only enables such concurrency
Test isolation guards (_no_repo_root_leaks, _no_repo_commits) misattribute external mutations to innocent tests and lack diagnostics (like returncode) needed to identify signal-killed children
Browser e2e probes killed by signal report empty stderr without indicating the kill, making signal-death indistinguishable from product regression
Detached runs are trustworthy when the checkout is isolated; the remedy is honest guard diagnostics and documented best practices, not skips or dismissal of detached validation
